notes.title: V.2.4
notes.content:
Guess what? Your favorite game just got a whole lot cooler! Now, you can play Ninja Stealth 5 with controllers and, the big news, with the Steam Deck!

Yep, you heard it right! Take your gaming to the next level with the Steam Deck. Play Ninja Stealth 5 anytime, anywhere, and keep the game’s quality top-notch.

Sure, we’ve got controller compatibility too, giving you more ways to play. But let’s be real, the Steam Deck is where it’s at!

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your Steam Deck, fire up Ninja Stealth 5, and get in on the action like never before!

Thanks for sticking with us, and we can’t wait to see you rule the game with the Steam Deck! Game on!
